static_traits.name: Zhu Li
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, close relationships with parents and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Good relationships with colleagues, but sometimes feeling distant due to negative mindset
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems experienced; no psychotherapy received; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear thinking, able to identify and describe one's own thinking patterns, good cooperativeness, calm tone

basic_info.main_problem: I always feel I work at the worst bank in the city, although it is not always busy, and this negative belief affects my emotions and Work motivation.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to find a way to stop these negative thoughts. I need to feel better about my work and improve my overall physical and mental health.
growth_experiences: After being transferred to a new branch six months ago, began continuously comparing with other branches; when Work pace is slower or customers complain, more easily triggering the belief 'this is the worst bank in the city'.

Having long held high expectations for Work, and tending to use other branches as reference standards; although having a supportive family and colleagues, has not yet confided negative thoughts to family.

core_beliefs: I work at the worst bank in the city

special_situations.event: Quieter workdays when work slows down and customer flow decreases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the branch is not busy, it means this bank is bad, has no future.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Deliberately focuses on positives (e.g. colleague support, good location), but they are quickly covered by negative thoughts.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not being busy proves this is the worst bank in the city.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a customer complains, it means the whole outlet's service is poor.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Does self-soothing and reframing, but the effect is brief.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is the worst bank in the city, and customers will see it that way too.

special_situations.event: After being transferred to a new branch, compares with other branches
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If not as busy or reputable as other branches, then this branch is bad, my Work has no value either.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Buffers frustration by emphasizing a few positive aspects, while labeling the outlet overall negatively to seek a sense of certainty.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Compared with other branches, this one is the worst.

special_situations.event: Repeatedly tries to focus on the positive but is still overwhelmed by negative thoughts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no sustained positive evidence, no merits count.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Listing positive points (colleague support, good location), then negating them.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These merits are useless too, this place is still the worst.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to gain a sense of value and recognition at work, and a sense of belonging to an excellent environment
core_conflict.fear: Fearing that being at the 'worst bank' means having no future, being negatively evaluated and belittled by others
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of control and avoiding disappointment by applying negative labels and keeping a certain emotional distance
Reducing asking family for help to avoid possible misunderstanding or ineffective support

object_relations.self_representation: Frustrated in a terrible environment, a Decreased-drive employee
object_relations.object_representation: The workplace and customers are experienced as harsh critics or an inferior institution

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to attend to positive experiences or question the 'worst' label
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to simplify complex Work reality into a single negative evaluation, believing the positive aspects are 'not enough to matter'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts an objective, neutral tone, emphasizing facts and efficiency, downplaying emotional feelings; if pressed about feelings, shifts to discussing data or processes.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether one discusses negative emotions and work troubles with family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: believing family will not understand, discussion will bring more disappointment or be unhelpful
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Explaining in Interpretative language 'they will not understand', Displacing the topic to external factors, avoiding in-depth emotional expression.

manifestations: Thinks one works at the worst bank in the city
Feels worthless and without prospects when work slows
Lost interest in activities once enjoyed at work and in life
outcomes: Decreased Work drive with performance affected
Weakened sense of connection with colleagues
Decreased enjoyment of life with eating habits affected

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not confiding negative thoughts to the supportive family
When frustrated at Work, bearing dissatisfaction and stress inwardly, rather than seeking external help

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes the busyness and reputation of other outlets as her own 'must' standard
Labels the current branch as 'the worst' based on external evaluation

positive_force: Good relationships with colleagues (colleague support and help)
Able to notice and name negative thinking patterns (such as overgeneralization, mind reading, etc.)
Actively tries to attend to positive aspects of work and environment
negative_force: High expectations and strong comparison tendency, prone to evaluating one's environment by others or other outlets as standards
Overgeneralization, mind reading, negating the positive and other cognitive biases repeatedly activated
Fluctuating Work pace (quiet periods, customer complaints) becoming significant triggers
Reduces seeking social support, leading to negative rumination and alienation

target_behavior.behavior: Negative labeling and automatic thoughts about the work environment (repeatedly deciding 'this is the worst bank in the city')
antecedent: Work slowing down or fewer customers
Compares with other branches after being transferred to a new one
target_behavior.core_reason: High expectations and strong comparison tendency triggering catastrophic and overgeneralizing cognitive Interpretations in slow-paced or complaint situations.
target_behavior.function: Gaining a sense of certainty and Self-protection through negative labels, escaping uncertainty and Anxiety in the short term.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased Work motivation and satisfaction, performance affected; Weakened sense of connection with colleagues; Decreased enjoyment of life affecting eating habits.
